Policies

Shipping, returns and refunds

Draft

This policy is a draft and is not yet in force. It is waiting for review by a licensed attorney. Nothing is on sale yet. Boxed words are details that will be filled in before launch.

This policy applies to purchases made directly on playbeforepixels.com from AlphaPlay LLC, doing business as Play Before Pixels. If you bought through a marketplace or bookstore (for example Amazon, Etsy, Teachers Pay Teachers, Faire or Bookshop.org), that seller's return policy applies — please contact them first, and we will help if we can.

Nothing in this policy limits any right you have under the consumer laws of the place where you live. Where local law gives you more, you get more.

Part A — Shipping

Where we ship

We ship to the United States and the countries listed at checkout. Some physical products are printed and shipped by print-on-demand partners or book distributors from facilities in the U.S. and other countries, so items in one order may arrive separately.

Processing and delivery times

ProductMade/processed inTypical delivery after processing
Books (paperback, hardcover, library binding)shown at checkout business daysU.S. shown at checkout business days; international shown at checkout business days
Card deck, printed play guideshown at checkout business dayssame as above
Print-on-demand apparel and merchshown at checkout business days (made to order)same as above
Digital downloadsinstant, by email and account page—

We ship within the time stated at checkout. If no time is stated, we ship within 30 days of your order. If we cannot ship on time, we will tell you promptly, give a new estimated date, and let you cancel for a full refund instead of waiting.

International orders: duties and taxes

Whether import duties are included is shown at checkout before you pay.

Lost or damaged in transit

Email us within 30 days of the expected delivery date with your order number (and a photo, if damaged). We will send a replacement or refund.

Address errors

Please check your address. If a package is returned because of an incorrect address, we will reship once you pay the new shipping cost, or refund the product price.

Part B — Returns & Refunds

1. Physical books, card decks and printed guides (stock items)

  • Return within 30 days of delivery in new, resaleable condition for a refund of the product price. Please email us first for return instructions.
  • Return shipping is paid by you unless the item was damaged, defective or wrong.
  • Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 10 business days of receiving the return.

2. Print-on-demand apparel and merch (made to order)

  • Because each item is made for you, we do not accept returns for change of mind, wrong size ordered, or color preference. Please check the size chart.
  • If an item arrives damaged, defective, misprinted or wrong, email us a photo within 30 days of delivery and we will replace it or refund it at no cost to you.

3. Digital downloads (printables, digital guide, classroom resource pack)

  • Because digital files can be kept once downloaded, digital products are generally non-refundable once the download link has been accessed.
  • We will always fix or refund if a file is corrupted, incomplete, materially different from its description, or you were charged twice.
  • For customers in the EU, UK and other places with a statutory cancellation right: at checkout we ask you to agree to immediate delivery and acknowledge that you lose your right to cancel once the download starts. If you did not give that consent, you may cancel within 14 days.

4. Online course — "30 Days of Back-and-Forth"

  • 14-day guarantee: If you are not satisfied, email us within 14 days of purchase for a full refund, as long as you have completed no more than 30% of the lessons.
  • After that, course fees are non-refundable, but you keep access for the stated access period.
  • If the course is sold on a payment plan, refunds are prorated to payments made and remaining installments are cancelled.
  • Memberships or subscriptions (if offered): the price, billing interval and renewal date are shown before you pay; you may cancel online at any time through account page / link in every receipt, and cancellation stops future charges. We send a reminder before any annual renewal.

6. Organization and bulk orders

Bulk orders, quotes, purchase orders, and group/advocacy kits follow the terms in the quote or invoice. Custom-printed or personalized bulk items are non-returnable except for defects.

7. How to request a return or refund

Emailthe email address on our contact page with your order number, the item, and the reason. Most answers are already in the FAQ in our help center at playbeforepixels.com/help, and every message gets a reply.

AlphaPlay LLC, d/b/a Play Before Pixels — mailing address added before launch
